summary: A student moving away from family must teach new attendants how to provide personal assistance.
realLife: Heather Tomko told senators that moving into a Carnegie Mellon dorm meant learning to direct paid attendants in tasks her parents had previously helped her do.
gates: The student has moved into campus housing and is directing a new attendant.
inGame: needs: the student’s residence, support plan and attendant experience.

turns.pulledBy: A trained worker is available for the new assignment.
turns.writesBack: The student can use the established routine.

turns.what: The new attendant learns part of the routine.
turns.writesBack: The care schedule records what still requires coverage.
